asset.label: Greater Trail Community Health Council: people-and-oval symbol and name, vector reconstruction
asset.sourceLocator: Rebuilt from a supplied screenshot of the logo (1166 × 488, research package source/Reference-Supplied-Screenshot.png), whose publication and date are not established; the motif is corroborated by the council’s archived 2001 website GIF
asset.dateNote: The screenshot it follows is undated; the 2001 website GIF dates a sighting of the design, not its adoption.
asset.notes: Three figures with oval heads rising from three nested oval bands, between “Greater” and “Trail” in serif capitals over a sloped rule, with “Community Health Council” below in widely spaced capitals and a heavier HEALTH, in black.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork, which has not been found. It follows a supplied screenshot, not the 2001 website GIF: the screenshot has heavier oval bands and differently lettered small capitals, so the two show one design family, not one master. The symbol is three analytic oval heads, three drawn body paths and three oval bands (no automatic tracing). GREATER and TRAIL are custom serif capitals; the caption is outlines derived from Albertus, the closest typeface tested. Neither typeface is confirmed, and all lettering is outlined. Overlap with the screenshot is about 0.90 overall (0.94 for the symbol, 0.78–0.84 for the words). No colour, designer or adoption date is asserted.
